> List every file a PRIDE project holds by walking its FTP directory tree, subdirectories included, with approximate sizes.

Wire verb `pride ftp-files` · Python [`pymzlib.pride.list_ftp_files`][pymzlib.pride.list_ftp_files]

### Wraps

- [`PrideArchiveClient.GetProjectFilesFromFtpAsync`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideArchiveClient.cs) in `mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideArchiveClient.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`PrideArchiveClient.GetProjectAsync`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideArchiveClient.cs) in `mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideArchiveClient.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`PrideFtpFile`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideFtpFile.cs) in `mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideFtpFile.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`PrideArchiveExtensions.TotalApproximateSizeBytes`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideArchiveExtensions.cs) in `mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideArchiveExtensions.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accession` | `string` | required | — | — | The project accession, e.g. PXD000001. The bridge checks only that it is not blank. mzLib resolves the project first (for its publication date, which locates the FTP directory), so an unknown accession fails instead of listing nothing. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accession` | `string` | — | never | The accession, echoed as given. |
| `file_count` | `int` | files | never | Entries in files. Since mzLib 1.0.594 (#1412) an empty root listing for a project that exists is retried and then thrown (see errors), so 0 means only that the root listed subdirectories that held no files. The bindings raise their not-found error on 0. |
| `approximate_total_size_bytes` | `int` | bytes | never | Sum of approximate_size_bytes (mzLib TotalApproximateSizeBytes): an estimate over the COMPLETE file list. PXD000001 comes to about 1.44 GB. |
| `files` | `object[]` | — | never | One entry per file in walk order (each directory's autoindex order, depth first); fields under result.columns. mzLib does not sort, so the order is PRIDE's and is not promised stable across requests. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `relative_path` | `string` | — | never | Path from the project's FTP root, '/'-separated and URL-decoded, e.g. generated/summary.mztab for a file in a subdirectory. |
| `file_name` | `string` | — | never | The last segment of relative_path. |
| `url` | `string` | — | never | HTTPS URL on ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk that the file can be fetched from with any HTTP client. |
| `approximate_size_bytes` | `int` | bytes | never | PRIDE's autoindex size (e.g. '429M'), expanded with 1024-based multipliers and so rounded to about three significant figures. 0 when the index showed '-' or an unparseable size: 0 means unknown, not empty. For the exact size, HTTP HEAD the url and read Content-Length. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | accession missing or blank |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | the bridge's own classification (Program.ClassifyError; since mzLib 1.0.593 (#1350) PRIDE raises every transport failure as an HttpRequestException carrying the cause or the status, and messages name the file and host, never the URL): a timeout or cancellation, a socket failure, a request that never got a response (refused connection, DNS, TLS), an HTTP 408, 429 or 5xx on the project lookup or on any directory listing, or a body cut off in transit |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | no project has that accession, or it has no publication date to locate its directory (MzLibException; the bindings re-map it to their not-found error); a directory listing answering any other status; nesting deeper than 64 levels (MzLibException: the listing may be cyclic); the project's root listing still empty after mzLib's retries (#1412: an HttpRequestException with no status and no cause, which mzLib treats as transient but the bridge cannot tell from a refusal, so it crosses as correctness until PRIDE-B3); a 403 from ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk after mzLib's retries (mzLib retries it as EBI's rate limit, but the bridge classifies by status, so it crosses as correctness; PRIDE-B3 asks mzLib to mark such failures) |

### Caveats

- Since mzLib 1.0.594 (#1412), PrideArchiveClient retries a transient failure, that request alone, after 5, 20 and 60 s (a 429 or 503 Retry-After of up to 60 s replaces the wait); transient means no HTTP status at all, 408, 429, any 5xx, or a 403 from ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk, EBI's rate limit. Each attempt can take up to the client's 100 s timeout, so a service that hangs takes up to about 485 s per request before the failure is reported. A binding's own timeout shorter than that reports a hanging outage as a timeout, not as service_unavailable.
- This is the complete file list; pride files (PRIDE's REST manifest) omits files, for PXD000001 five of 14 on 2026-10-21, including the two largest. The price is metadata: no category, checksum or CV locations here.
- Sizes are approximate (rounded autoindex values), so approximate_total_size_bytes is an estimate, but an estimate over every file, unlike pride files' total_size_bytes.
- A listing surface only: pride download selects from the REST manifest, so a file that appears only here cannot be fetched by pride download. Fetch it from its url with an ordinary HTTPS client.
- One HTTP request per directory: the walk's cost grows with the tree, not the file count.

### Example

```python
ftp = pymzlib.pride.list_ftp_files('PXD000001')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`pride_PXD000001_ftp_files.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/pride_PXD000001_ftp_files.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.

!!! warning "Not yet verified"

    - An unknown accession crosses as correctness (MzLibException), not usage, although it is the caller's mistake; the wire has no 'not found'. Each binding re-maps it, but not alike: pyMzLib matches mzLib's two not-found messages, while mzLibRust and mzLibR re-map every MzLibException, so the 64-level cyclic-listing failure also reads as not found there.
